Usage: actual [options] [command]

CLI for Actual Budget

Options:
  -V, --version                     output the version number
  --server-url <url>                Actual server URL (env: ACTUAL_SERVER_URL)
  --password <password>             Server password (env: ACTUAL_PASSWORD)
  --session-token <token>           Session token (env: ACTUAL_SESSION_TOKEN)
  --sync-id <id>                    Budget sync ID (env: ACTUAL_SYNC_ID)
  --data-dir <path>                 Data directory (env: ACTUAL_DATA_DIR)
  --encryption-password <password>  E2E encryption password (env:
                                    ACTUAL_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD)
  --cache-ttl <seconds>             Cache TTL in seconds (env: ACTUAL_CACHE_TTL;
                                    default: 60)
  --refresh                         Force a sync on this call, ignoring the
                                    cache (default: false)
  --no-cache                        Alias for --refresh
  --lock-timeout <seconds>          How long to wait for another CLI process to
                                    release the lock (env: ACTUAL_LOCK_TIMEOUT;
                                    default: 10)
  --no-lock                         Disable the budget directory lock (use with
                                    care, env: ACTUAL_NO_LOCK)
  --format <format>                 Output format: json, table, csv (choices:
                                    "json", "table", "csv", default: "json")
  --verbose                         Show informational messages (default: false)
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Commands:
  accounts                          Manage accounts
  budgets                           Manage budgets
  categories                        Manage categories
  category-groups                   Manage category groups
  transactions                      Manage transactions
  payees                            Manage payees
  tags                              Manage tags
  rules                             Manage transaction rules
  schedules                         Manage scheduled transactions
  query                             Run AQL (Actual Query Language) queries
  server                            Server utilities
  sync [options]                    Sync the local cached budget with the
                                    server, print cache status, or clear the
                                    cache
  help [command]                    display help for command
